summary.goal: Capture user decisions as trajectory events using @agent-relay/trajectory library, enable agents to query past answers before asking, and build a preference model over time.

acceptance_criteria.description: Event includes question context, selected option, free text, reasoning
Event links to agent trajectory via trajectoryId
Agents query trajectory via listTrajectorySteps() for similar decisions
If similar question found, agent uses existing answer (no re-ask)
Decision Log view renders trajectory data with filtering
Preference model derived from trajectory queries
Agents can query preference model to order options intelligently

steps.title: Remove custom trajectory_events table
steps.description: Remove trajectory_events table from src/storage/schema.ts. Remove related methods from sqlite.ts (createTrajectoryEvent, listTrajectoryEvents, findSimilarQuestions). Clean up trajectory storage interface.

acceptance_criteria.description: trajectory_events table definition removed from schema.ts

steps.title: Refactor TrajectoryService to use @agent-relay/trajectory
steps.description: Update src/trajectory/service.ts to import from @agent-relay/trajectory. Use recordDecision(), listTrajectorySteps(), getTrajectoryHistory(). Remove custom SQL storage. Maintain same public API for handlers.

acceptance_criteria.description: Same public interface maintained for handlers

steps.title: Update API handlers to use refactored service
steps.description: Update src/api/handlers/trajectories.ts to work with refactored TrajectoryService. Same HTTP endpoints, now backed by relay trajectory. Update response format if needed to match relay types.

acceptance_criteria.description: Response types align with relay trajectory format

steps.title: Update domain types to match relay trajectory
steps.description: Update src/domain/trajectory.ts to align DecisionEvent with @agent-relay/trajectory DecisionOptions. Remove redundant types. Keep DerivedPreference for preference calculation.

steps.title: Update frontend types to match new backend
steps.description: Update packages/planner-ui/src/types/trajectory.ts to match refactored backend types. Ensure DecisionEvent matches relay trajectory format.

steps.title: Test refactored trajectory integration
steps.description: Test that decisions are recorded via relay trajectory. Verify listTrajectorySteps returns decisions. Test preference derivation still works. Verify API endpoints return correct data.

acceptance_criteria.description: Decisions recorded to relay trajectory storage
